avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate immune stimulation and increase risk of adverse effects when combined with sargramostim's immune-activating properties
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider discontinuation 1-2 weeks before sargramostim initiation

avoid_supplements.name: Interferon-alpha supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive immune stimulation may increase risk of cytokine storm, fever, and inflammatory complications

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin C (high-dose >2g daily)
caution_supplements.mechanism: May enhance immune activation; monitor for excessive inflammatory response
caution_supplements.action: Limit to recommended dietary allowance; monitor clinical response

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild immune stimulation may have additive effects with sargramostim
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution and monitor for increased adverse effects

avoid_foods.name: High-sodium processed foods
avoid_foods.mechanism: Sargramostim can cause fluid retention; excessive sodium increases this risk and may worsen cardiovascular effects
avoid_foods.action: Maintain low sodium intake (<2,300 mg/day); monitor fluid balance and weight

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: May inhibit metabolism of concurrent medications used with sargramostim therapy
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; consider alternative beverages if taking multiple medications

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May impair absorption of oral medications co-administered with sargramostim
caution_foods.action: Space meals appropriately from medication administration if needed

monitoring_notes: Sargramostim is a biologic cytokine with minimal direct supplement-drug interactions; monitoring should focus on additive immune stimulation effects and fluid/electrolyte balance given sargramostim's known adverse effects. Regular assessment of CBC, platelet count, and fluid status is essential during therapy.
